work.title: Dokumente zur «Philosophie der Freiheit»
work.source_summary: The volume combines a facsimile of the 1894 edition and annotated/manuscript/review materials. Current extraction has high image coverage but extensive un-cross-checked U+0002 signals and seven textless pages; sampled secondary-engine checks cover only three pages. Require targeted OCR/visual validation and preserve facsimile assets before calling the text a passable EPUB basis.
